subject: Tenant admin entitlements & initial API seed — kickoff
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Gupta <sana.g@clearwell.io>, Tom Li <tom.li@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant admin entitlements & initial API seed — kickoff

Hi Sana / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our handoff with Sales, this thread will track the initial tenant and admin provisioning work so your engineering and security teams have the right access to start integration tests. I’ve attached a draft entitlement matrix and a one-page setup checklist for visibility.

High-level plan (week 0):
- Seed: create initial workspace/project and provision two API keys (admin & ingest) scoped to test namespace.
- Roles: nominate 2 admins + 3 engineers; we’ll create roles in the project and seed service accounts.
- Invites: staged invites — admins first, engineers 24h after admin acceptance.
- Audit & keys: enable audit logging and rotate the admin key after validation.

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm the two admin nominees (name + email) we should invite.
2) Confirm whether Clearwell requires HSM-backed keys or if KMS is sufficient for initial tests.
3) Any IP allowlist ranges for the initial test agents?

Attachments: tenant-entitlement-matrix.xlsx (matrix with proposed roles/scopes), redwood-initial-setup-checklist.pdf (short checklist + rollback rows).

Proposed next step: 30-min sync today or tomorrow to confirm nominees and timeline. I’ve copied Monica (CS lead) and Connor (onboarding engineer) — they’ll run the onboarding steps.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0118

---
From: Sana Gupta <sana.g@clearwell.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@bluepeak.io>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant admin entitlements & initial API seed — kickoff

Thanks Markus — this looks good. Quick answers from our side: 

- Admin nominees: Sana Gupta (sana.g@clearwell.io) and Tom Li (tom.li@bluepeak.io). Will confirm full legal names in a follow-up.
- HSM vs KMS: For POC we are fine with KMS; production will require HSM. We’d prefer KMS for the initial seed to avoid procurement delays.
- IP ranges: engineering egress will come from our staging CIDR 10.120.32.0/22; security will verify if that needs to be narrowed.

One more ask: can the admin API key be scoped so it cannot delete production namespaces? We want strict separation; if you can share the exact role capabilities in the matrix that helps.

Happy to do a stand-up at 11:30 if that works for your team.

- Sana
Sana Gupta
Dir. of Engineering — Clearwell Health
sana.g@clearwell.io

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Gupta <sana.g@clearwell.io>, Tom Li <tom.li@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant admin entitlements & initial API seed — kickoff

Appreciate the quick reply, Sana. Answers & proposed mutual action plan below.

Role scoping: Attached matrix maps the admin key to Workspace.Admin (create/read/update on test workspaces, no delete on prod namespaces). We’ll implement a conditional policy that blocks delete actions on any resource tagged environment:production. That policy will be enforced on the seeded admin key.

Mutual action plan (concrete):
- Today (by 16:00 PT): Redwood to seed workspace and create two keys (admin-test, ingest-test) with conditional policy. 
- Tomorrow 09:00 PT: Redwood sends admin invites to Sana + Tom. They accept and validate access. 
- Day 2: Connor runs CR (connectivity run) to validate API calls from your staging CIDR. He’ll drop results in the shared Drive folder.
- Day 3: Rotate admin-test key and hand over service account patterns for your infra to adopt.

Request for Clearwell: provide the preferred email for platform notifications (invite/resend) and a signed TLS fingerprint expectation if you have one.

Calendar: I can take the 11:30 slot — marking that as a short sync for nominees & CIDR confirmation. Connor will use the call to confirm the connectivity checklist.

Connor, can you provision the workspace (dev-clearwell) and drop the seeded key names here once done?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
